reason: CHELSA-TraCE21k is terrestrial climate; aquatic populations cannot be used as a direct response to terrestrial bioclimatic history. Restrict before response opening.
identity: Spec_id + Study_id joins must be 1:1; exclude missing-key workbook rows; no outcome-based filtering
response_mask: He numeric-cell presence only; no He values, GD_Nei, Ho, allele frequencies, genetic correlations or genotypes accessed prior to response-open authorization
train_evaluation: SHA256('ttf-fresh-quaternary-gendivrange-v01|'+lowercase(Spec_Latin_GenDivRange)) first digest byte parity; all studies of same species same role
analysis_mechanics: Use study/species fixed effects via within-group population contrasts; compare held-out species squared-error difference between 0BP-only + geography + study sampling controls and that model plus the one frozen historical-change magnitude term; cluster unit species, not pairs.
effect_test: Two-sided coefficient and predeclared directional sensitivity are reported without post-hoc choice; main decision is held-out prediction gain, with species-level uncertainty.
climate: Only original CHELSA-TraCE21k 21ka and 0BP bio01/bio07/bio12/bio15 at corresponding present-day genotype sampling locations; reject offshore/NA cells before opening He numeric outcomes
freeze_boundary: Do not modify TTF-Q manuscript, prior genetic Phase4, or relational v0.3 closed family. Failure to meet eligibility or climate support => NOT_EVALUABLE.
